name: Varga Surplus
blurb: A reclamation yard that sells gateway hardware pulled from decommissioned racks.
banner: every board was in a rack. every rack was in a building that closed.

content.text:
VARGA RECLAMATION · YARD LIST

Processors. Storage. Modems. Connection cards. Coolers.

Everything here is pulled from a building that was shut down and is sold for less than the Backroom asks. The very top boards are not in the yard; they go to a buyer who does not haggle.

We do not sell programs. We do not take contracts.
Tested on delivery. Installed on payment. Whatever you pull out of your gateway goes to the scrapper, not back to you.
